wire.settings.keymap.new_session.label: New session
wire.settings.keymap.new_session.help: Starts a fresh conversation, the same as /new.
wire.settings.keymap.resume.label: Resume a session
wire.settings.keymap.resume.help: Opens the picker of recent conversations, the same as /resume.
wire.settings.keymap.quick_send.label: Quick send
wire.settings.keymap.quick_send.help: Opens a small composer over other apps; messages the chief of staff.
wire.settings.keymap.push_to_talk.label: Push to talk
wire.settings.keymap.push_to_talk.help: Hold to dictate (desktop); release to stop.
wire.settings.keymap.start_recording.hel: Starts speech-to-text recording in the desktop window.
wire.settings.keymap.send_steer.label: Send as steer
wire.settings.keymap.send_steer.help: Send now, interrupting the step. Overrides Delivery when busy.
wire.settings.keymap.send_queue.label: Send as queue
wire.settings.keymap.send_queue.help: Wait for the step; never interrupt tools. Overrides Delivery when busy.
wire.settings.keymap.send_both.label: Send as queue, then steer
wire.settings.keymap.send_both.help: Wait, then steer if slow. Overrides Delivery when busy.
